messages:
katy: Packaging FYI — staging bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/installer/2026-03-21/sha256:abcd1234
mo: Nice. Did we shrinkwrap the offline payload?
katy: yes, shrinkwrap v2 applied. checksums attached. signer handoff scheduled for 16:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary job queued for private-installer:v2026-03-21-rc3
jess: Can we hold the canary window to 30m? customers in APAC are still running long-running tests.
sam: +1 to 30m. Also request a rollforward gate: if canary latency p95 > 250ms for >5m auto-revert.
ops-signer: KMS handoff ready. I'll attach cosign sig after we confirm the image tag is pinned.
katy: Tag pinned to `installer-2026-03-21-rc3` — DO NOT promote without ops-signer approval.
mo: Quick preflight commands I ran:
```
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | cut -d' ' -f1
cosign verify --key $SIGNER_PUBLIC bundle.tar.gz
```
jess: deploy-bot, what's the canary rollout plan?
deploy-bot: canary: 5% nodes for 30m, healthcheck `/healthz` p95 < 200ms, fallback to v2026-03-20 if failing. Will post status updates here.
sam: If healthcheck flaps due to cold-start, ignore the first 90s of pod boot for policy evaluation.
katy: Added startup grace 90s to the health policy and enabled prefix cache-warm on canary nodes.
philip: For rollback playbook: if we trigger rollback, revert to `installer-2026-03-20` and re-run signoff. Notify infra + support.
jess: Release notes: add "airgap: improved delta apply reliability" and note cosign signer rotation guidance.
ops-signer: Signed at 16:07 UTC — cosign signature recorded (signature id: sig-20260321-16:07).
deploy-bot: canary started @4012350100
mo: Watching logs: deploy-bot reported one pod CrashLoop at t+4m but it auto-restarted and passed readiness.
sam: Observability action: temporary alert `canary-pod-restarts` -> page oncall if >2 restarts in 15m.
katy: Decision time: continue canary or abort? Current metrics: p95=180ms, error-rate=0.1%.
jess: Continue. Wait the full 30m then decide. Abort if errors exceed 0.5% in any 5m window.
deploy-bot: canary complete @4012350299 — health OK. Promoting to 50% per plan for next window.
philip: Marking release-notes draft with final checksum and signer reference.
katy: Good. Post-rollback checklist: if we rollback, collect bundle logs + cosign verification output + KMS audit trace.
sam: I'll keep the staging hold open for 1 hour after full rollout before final mirror push to airgap mirrors.
jess: Thanks team — I'll start the customer comms and ship notes."
